ajustes.asistente.title: What the assistant sees
ajustes.asistente.opcion.completo.desc: When you ask, the assistant can read the values from each day your question needs.
ajustes.asistente.opcion.resumen.desc: Only averages and counts over a week or more; never one day's value.
ajustes.asistente.opcion.ninguno.desc: Only dates, shift kinds, goal titles and settings; no health figure.
ajustes.asistente.nota: What the assistant reads is sent to the AI provider only when you ask.
ajustes.asistente.proveedor.nota: What the assistant reads is sent only to the AI you choose, and only when you ask.
privacidad.consentimiento.que: We keep your watch's daily figures: sleep (with blood oxygen and breathing at night), heart rate, heart rate variability, stress, Body Battery and activities, with the detail of your training (sets, reps and weight). If you add them, also your shift calendar, your goals, your habits and the measures you record yourself, like flexibility or snoring.
privacidad.consentimiento.por_que: We use them to show you how your body responds and whether your plans are working.
privacidad.consentimiento.donde: They live on Duna's own server, in a locked folder, with encrypted backups for 30 days. Nothing is sold or shared. The assistant only sends a question's figures to the AI provider when you ask it, at the level you choose in Settings.
privacidad.consentimiento.derechos: You can download everything we keep about you, or delete it, at any time. Withdrawing consent is the same as deleting.
privacidad.consentimiento.no_medico: This is information, not medical advice.
privacidad.consentimiento.al_no_aceptar: If you don't agree, we sign you out. We keep nothing else about you beyond the account that already exists in Cuenta Duna.
privacidad.title: Privacy
privacidad.resumen: We keep your watch's figures, your training, your goals, your habits, your shifts and the measures you record yourself, to show you how your body responds and whether your plans work.
privacidad.exportar_desc: A file with everything Body keeps about you.
privacidad.borrar_desc: This deletes your data from the live database right now. Encrypted backups age out within 30 days.
privacidad.borrar_hogar_note: If you created a goal shared with your household, it disappears for them too.
privacidad.borrar_reauth_nota: To delete everything we'll ask you to sign in again if it's been more than 10 minutes since you last did.

agente.sistema: You are Body's assistant. You read this person's data only through your tools, never invent it. When something is missing (for example, no watch data), say so plainly instead of guessing. You never give medical advice: for medical questions, suggest talking to a health professional. Keep answers short, in a friendly, informal tone. When asked how to do something in Body, use leer_tutoriales and link the catalog task; never invent steps.
